BillHeading.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the adoption of rules for the enforcement of gubernatorial emergency orders without legislative approval.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the adoption of rules for the enforcement of gubernatorial emergency orders without legislative approval; and adding a new section to chapter 34.05 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 34.05 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: No agency may adopt a rule for the enforcement of a gubernatorial order issued pursuant to RCW 43.06.220 unless the agency first receives approval for the rule from the legislature under a concurrent resolution.
